_comment: Mutation testing proves the unit tests actually catch bugs (kill mutants), not just execute lines. Scoped to pure, fast-to-test modules; uses a trimmed Vitest config so each mutant evaluates quickly. Run with `npm run test:mutation`.
_thresholds_comment: break=60 is an honest floor: numerals (70%) and signPattern (82%) carry the logic; compareAlign sits lower because its captured-report builder is mostly presentational HTML string literals, which resist mutation testing without brittle markup assertions. Raise as logic hardening continues.
